std.description: Uncertainty: Lisflood SWS deviation from the ensemble mean of SWS storage (Lisflood and WGHM).

limitations: Model-derived GloFAS version 4.0 LISFLOOD surface water combines river, lake and artificial reservoir storage; not observation-based reservoir validation.
250 km Gaussian-filtered compartment must not be assumed spatially identical to another GRACE product.
Record ends September 2023; do not extrapolate subsequent surface water observations.
